name: Kim Wallan

bio.statement: Wallan's pamphlet statement lists her occupation as State Representative and her occupational background as attorney.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative Occupational Background: Attorney

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

bio.statement: She lists prior governmental experience on the Medford School Board, City Council and Urban Renewal Agency, and House Republican leadership roles.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Medford School Board; Medford City Council; Medford Urban Renewal Agency; State Representative; House Minority Deputy Leader; House Minority Whip

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

bio.statement: She lists a B.S. in Political Science and a J.D., both from Willamette University.
bio.excerpt: Willamette University, B.S. Political Science; Willamette University College of Law, J.D.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

bio.statement: Her official page says she represents House District 6, which includes all but a few neighborhoods in Medford.
bio.excerpt: I am honored to represent the people of House District 6, which includes all but a few neighborhoods in the city of Medford.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Kim Wallan official page

positions.statement: Wallan says she passed laws to make the state safer, working with law enforcement and district attorneys to recriminalize street drugs.
positions.excerpt: I have passed several laws that make our state safer. As Judiciary Vice Chair, I’ve worked alongside law enforcement and district attorneys to recriminalize street drugs,

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

positions.statement: Wallan says land use restrictions and taxes artificially raise prices of goods from housing to groceries.
positions.excerpt: Land use restrictions and taxes artificially raise the price of everything from housing to groceries.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

positions.statement: Wallan says she joined voters in rejecting a new gas tax in May and will push for accountability for state spending.
positions.excerpt: I joined you in soundly rejecting a new gas tax in May, and I will continue to push for accountability for all of this spending

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

positions.statement: Wallan says she is committed to fighting illegal cannabis grows and improving forest management to reduce wildfire risk.
positions.excerpt: remain particularly committed to fighting illegal cannabis grows and improving forest management to reduce wildfire risk.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 3, p. 40)

positions.statement: Reported by KATU, Wallan sponsored a bill to end cell phone use during school hours and plans to reintroduce it.
positions.excerpt: State Rep. Kim Wallan of Medford, who sponsored the bill to eliminate cell phone use during school hours, expressed her support for the executive order and plans to reintroduce the bill to solidify the policy in statute.

positions.statement: A March 2025 Willamette Week headline reports that Wallan asked for a federal investigation of the Oregon Youth Authority.
positions.excerpt: Rep. Kim Wallan Asks for Federal Investigation of Oregon Youth Authority
